remarks: Welcome to 125 Prospect, a bright and spacious Top-Floor, End Unit 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom condo just minutes from downtown Stamford! Whether you're looking for a place to call home or a great investment opportunity, this unit checks all the boxes.  Step inside to find hardwood floors throughout, adding warmth and elegance to the open-concept layout. The spacious primary suite features a huge walk-in closet and a private bath, while the second bedroom offers flexibility for guests or even a home office.   As a top-floor end unit, enjoy added privacy and quieter living. Plus, Heat and Hot Water are INCLUDED in the HOA common charges, providing additional value and convenience!  With restaurants, shopping, entertainment, and public transportation all within walking distance, this location offers both convenience and strong rental demand.  Don't miss this prime opportunity to own in one of Stamford's most desirable locations!
